sourceMaterial.exclusions: Do not assume that accountability is unsupported solely because a Leader selects Directing Work. Some decisions may appropriately remain with leadership.
sourceMaterial.testScenario: Squad selected Team Owns Outcomes; Leader selected Directing Work and Control-Based Leadership. Contrast with Leader selected Enabling Team Autonomy.
sourceMaterial.expectedInterpretation: Possible tension between the Squad's responsibility for outcomes and its reported scope to make decisions. Validate whether the Squad has the authority it needs to fulfil its accountability.
